en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate exhibition pavilion with arched windows and decorative rooflines, set in landscaped gardens with trees, shrubs, and lampposts. A tall flagpole with a long vertical flag stands in front. The red printed Hungarian captions at the top read "Pécsi országos kiállítás" and "Közoktatásügyi pavillon." The reverse side is a typical divided back with the heading "LEVELEZŐ LAP" and a credit line at the bottom.
